latestVersion.changelog:
- Major release introducing the "high-agency" skill, an evolved system for sustained high agency inspired by and supplementing corporate PUA methods.
- Adds protocols for session startup (builder-journal review, "good enough" calibration), quality compasses, and battle log tracking.
- Implements five iron rules for agency: unyielding pursuit, self-led troubleshooting, end-to-end ownership, full-link review, and systematic knowledge reuse.
- Introduces the Recovery Protocol, allowing self-recovery before external pressure escalates, with progressive pressure levels on repeated failures.
- Builds persistent cross-session learning by logging lessons in `builder-journal.md` and escalating trust levels based on consistent high-quality output.
- Provides structured checklists, agency enforcements, and metacognitive reflection protocols to foster ownership, initiative, and resilience across all complex tasks.
